dataset: Natural Earth land v5.1.2 at 1:10 million scale
processing: Lakes excluded from land rendering and inspection. Coordinates rounded to 4 decimal degrees; properties omitted; geometry gzip/base64 embedded. No handmade island polygons added.
rendering: Default categorical production review: Cyprus-specific commercial siting flags use native DEM cells; seasonal constraints flag other risk; gray is unverified annual production. No green raster areas or station-temperature interpolation. Optional seasonal climate view samples native CHELSA windows and the embedded overview with valid-neighbor interpolation. Both views use the same detailed land/lake clipping.
